The 3 `ui` commands of the editor at engine `319075e3f92b`: each with its description, its kind, the MCP toolsets that offer it, its parameters and their JSON Schema (the other groups have files of their own).

## ui.create

Creates a game UI element ready to use, in one undo step (while playing it changes the running copy only): a canvas, a panel (a rounded, framed background), an image, a text, a button (with its label), a toggle (with box, checkmark and label), a slider (with track, fill and handle), an input field (a line the player types into, with its text and placeholder; Enter calls OnUISubmit) or a horizontal, vertical or grid layout group. An element whose parent is outside every canvas (or that has none) gets a new top-level canvas first. anchor places it on its parent (and sets the pivot to match); position and size are in canvas units (along a stretched axis size is added to the parent's span: 0 fills it). Returns entity, canvas, created (every new entity), parts (label, background, fill, handle, checkmark, placeholder, as the type has them) and rect (\[x, y, width, height\] in pixels at the game's screen).

Kind: `Edit` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `ui` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: yes · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorUICommands.cpp:224`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `anchor` | string | no |   | Where it sits on its parent: topLeft, topCenter, topRight, topStretch, middleLeft, middleCenter, middleRight, middleStretch, bottomLeft, bottomCenter, bottomRight, bottomStretch, stretchLeft, stretchCenter, stretchRight, stretch (default middleCenter). |
| `name` | string | no |   | The element's name (default: the type's, e.g. &quot;Button&quot;). |
| `parent` | string or null | no |   | The parent (a canvas or an element of one; outside a canvas a new canvas is made) (entity ID or null). |
| `position` | array of number | no |   | \[x, y\]: the pivot's offset from the anchors in canvas units, +y down (default \[0, 0\]). Items: at least 2, at most 2. |
| `size` | array of number | no |   | \[width, height\] in canvas units (default: the type's; along stretched axes 0). Items: at least 2, at most 2. |
| `text` | string | no |   | The text of a text, button or toggle, or an input field's placeholder (default &quot;New Text&quot;, &quot;Button&quot;, &quot;Toggle&quot;, &quot;Enter text...&quot;). |
| `type` | string | yes |   | What to create: canvas, panel, image, text, button, toggle, slider, inputField, horizontalLayout, verticalLayout, gridLayout. |

## ui.hitTest

What the player would hit at a position of the game's screen (edit and play mode): the topmost raycast target (an image or text that is one, or a selectable) of the canvases that receive input, as entity, name, path (from its canvas), selectable (the selectable it belongs to, which a click would press) and interactable; entity null when the position hits nothing. World-space canvases are hit where the scene's camera looks through the position, after every screen-space canvas. With all, every element whose rect contains the position, topmost first, raycast target or not, in every canvas.

Kind: `Query` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `ui` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: no · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorUICommands.cpp:414`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `all` | boolean | no |   | List every element at the position instead (default false). |
| `position` | array of number | yes |   | \[x, y\] in screen pixels from the top-left corner. Items: at least 2, at most 2. |
| `screen` | array of integer | no |   | \[width, height\] of the screen in pixels (default: the game's screen: while playing the game view's image, in edit mode the viewport's image, without either 1920x1080). Items: at least 2, at most 2. |

## ui.layout

Where the game UI's elements are at a screen size, without rendering: the root canvases (entity, name, scale in pixels per canvas unit, unitSize, sortOrder, receivesInput) and the elements of an entity's subtree (all canvases without one), in draw order: entity, name, rect (\[x, y, width, height\] in screen pixels; on a canvas in the scene (worldSpace) in canvas units, with screenRect where the scene's camera shows it), visible, visibleRect for elements under a UI Mask (what its clip rect leaves of the rect: where it is drawn and clicked), and for selectables interactable, state (normal, hover, pressed, focused, disabled) and focused, for texts and input fields text (and editing for a field the player types into), for sliders and toggles value. At most 1,000 elements (truncated tells). Check that a HUD keeps its proportions by comparing rects at several screens.

Kind: `Query` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `ui` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: no · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorUICommands.cpp:333`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `entity` | string or null | no |   | A canvas or element whose subtree to list (default: every canvas) (entity ID or null). |
| `screen` | array of integer | no |   | \[width, height\] of the screen in pixels (default: the game's screen: while playing the game view's image, in edit mode the viewport's image, without either 1920x1080). Items: at least 2, at most 2. |
